traditional: Safety meets the hunger safety was built to silence; comfort and the banished appetite cannot both run the evening.

modern.blend: Restlessness inside a pleasant routine; ask what the want underneath would order if it could speak.
modern.harmonious: The appetite gets named without wrecking the nest; comfort expands to include it.
modern.hard: The mood with no name that is a want with no permission; comfort eating standing in for desire.
modern.business: Cozy stability chafes; schedule one outlet before the restlessness picks one.
